mainEntity.name: How long does custom window installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of custom window installation varies depending on the number of windows, their complexity, and the specific requirements of your home. The process often involves an initial consultation, measurement, custom manufacturing, and then the installation itself. Manufacturing can take several weeks, followed by one to several days for installation. For Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, and Emeryville homeowners, we provide a detailed project timeline after assessing the scope of work during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom window installation timelines vary based on the number and complexity of windows, including manufacturing and installation time, typically spanning several weeks overall.
